exceptions.rationale: Re-evaluated 2026-09-28 for the 2.1.0 release against unchanged checksum-verified paste 1.0.15, tokenizers 0.22.2 and fastembed 5.17.2. paste is an unmaintained build-time procedural macro; tokenizers uses it to construct fixed serde helper identifiers. Runtime history and model inputs are not passed to the macro. Build-time execution and maintenance risk remain. Published tokenizers 0.23.2 still requires paste, and compatible fastembed 5.17.4 retains tokenizers 0.22.2; neither removes the finding. Adopting pastey requires a separately validated parent dependency change. Accept only this exact locked finding through 2026-10-05, with re-evaluation before expiry and removal when the dependency is actually removed or replaced. No advisory gate or dependency identity is broadened.

Re-evaluated 2026-09-28 for the 2.1.0 release against unchanged checksum-verified lru 0.16.4 and Tantivy 0.26.1. The reported LruCache::pop defect requires a panicking key destructor and reuse after unwinding. Tantivy uses a private LruCache<usize, OwnedBytes> for stored documents, with new/get/put/len and destruction; inspected operations do not call pop and usize has no panicking destructor. Larger histories increase cache activity without introducing those missing preconditions. This is specific to the reported defect, not a memory-safety certification of the dependency. Published compatible Tantivy 0.26.2 still requires lru ^0.16.3, excluding fixed versions >=0.18.2; upstream 0.27 is an unpublished broader migration. Accept only this exact locked finding through 2026-10-05. Re-evaluate before expiry or if the cache caller/key type changes; remove the exception after validated dependency remediation. Unsafe dependency code and residual uncertainty remain.
